note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The full transcript (doctor-patient conversation)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) as JSON

Notes:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source of factual information.
- I will use the DDx to enrich clinical reasoning only when consistent with the transcript; if there is a conflict, I will include both statements and mark “conflict noted.”
- I will extract only clinically relevant information (presenting complaint, onset/duration/progression, PMH, meds, allergies, physical findings, working diagnosis and differentials from DDx when consistent, management/treatment, and follow-up).
- If a medication is mentioned without dose/route/frequency, I will record the name and append “dose/route/frequency not documented.”
- I will adhere to American English, concise, professional tone.
- The final output will follow the exact structure:
  Subjective:
  - …
  Objective:
  - …
  Assessment & Plan:
  1. Issue, Problem, or Request 1 (condition name only):
     - Assessment
     - Differential diagnoses (from DDx if consistent; include likelihood if available)
     - Investigations planned
     - Treatments planned
     - Referrals
  2. Issue 2 …
  3. Issue 3, 4, 5 (as needed)
  Quality checks:
  - Missing but clinically expected elements
  - Internal conflicts between transcript and DDx (mark “conflict noted”)
  - Brief comment on transcript quality if noisy/inaudible

If you prefer, you can paste the transcript and DDx directly in this chat.
